about_short_description.short_description: Luxury Presence is a website and marketing system used by the world’s leading real estate agents and brokers.

product.name: Real Estate Websites
product.description: Custom, mobile-optimized websites for real estate agents, teams, and brokerages, with IDX search, MLS listing synchronization, lead capture, content tools, and seller valuation features.

product.name: AI CRM
product.description: A real estate CRM that organizes contacts, detects buying and selling signals, scores leads, and recommends prioritized outreach with draft messages.

product.name: SEO & GEO
product.description: Search optimization services and tools that improve real estate website visibility across Google and AI-powered search platforms through technical, content, and local optimization.

product.name: Paid Ads Management
product.description: Managed digital advertising for real estate businesses, including campaign strategy, lead-generation ads, landing pages, audience targeting, and performance support.

product.name: AI Lead Nurture
product.description: An automated SMS service that responds to inbound leads, qualifies their interest, maintains conversations over time, and alerts agents when leads are ready for direct contact.

product.name: Social Media Management
product.description: Managed social media marketing for real estate professionals, including branded content planning, production, publishing, and channel growth support.
